pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large polygonal regions with sharp-edged pixel gradients. Patches exhibit high contrast against the lighter background, with spatial area being largest on the mid-flank and decreasing in size towards the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-colored pathways forming a network of interconnected nodes. Intersections are primarily tri-nodal, with the pixel thickness of the corridors remaining relatively thin and uniform across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude sawtooth silhouette visible along the dorsal neck mane. Individual hair structures create a jagged 1D geometric contour against the out-of-focus background.
